heading: Thursday, January 16, 2025
topLine: Microsoft's MatterGen designs a material that was synthesised; its novelty is later disputed.

items.headline: Microsoft's MatterGen designs a material that was synthesised; its novelty is later disputed
items.summary: Microsoft Research's generative diffusion model MatterGen (Nature) proposed TaCr2O6 when conditioned on a 200 GPa bulk modulus, and a team at the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology synthesised it with Ta/Cr disorder and measured 169 GPa. A 2026 Materials Horizons analysis by Mikkel Juelsholt argues the synthesised phase is crystallographically identical to Ta1/2Cr1/2O2, reported in 1971 and already present in MatterGen's training data.

image.alt: Experimental validation of the MatterGen-generated compound TaCr2O6
